FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY --from=builder /usr/bin/jq /usr/bin/jq
COPY --from=builder /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjq.so.1 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjq.so.1

proposals.rationale: Mike asked for a URL page-reading capability. This tested verb accepts a caller-supplied HTTP/HTTPS URL, validates that every resolved IPv4 address is public, pins curl to the validated address to resist DNS rebinding, rejects URL credentials and unsupported content types, caps the transfer at 1 MiB and output at 200 kB, applies strict timeouts, does not follow redirects, and keeps no persistent state. verb.description: Read a public HTTP or HTTPS page and print readable text. The verb rejects credentials, non-public IPv4 destinations, oversized responses, and non-text content; it pins the request to its validated DNS result and keeps no state.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' \
'#!/usr/bin/perl' \
'use strict; use warnings; use Socket qw(inet_aton);' \
'my $u=shift // die "invalid URL\n";' \
'$u =~ m{^(https?)://([A-Za-z0-9.-]+)(?::([0-9]{1,5}))?(?:[/?#]|$)}i or die "only HTTP/HTTPS URLs with an ASCII hostname and no credentials are allowed\n";' \
'my ($scheme,$host,$port)=(lc($1),lc($2),$3);' \
'$host =~ /^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9.-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$/ or die "invalid hostname\n";' \
'$host !~ /\.\./ or die "invalid hostname\n";' \
'$port ||= $scheme eq "https" ? 443 : 80; $port<=65535 or die "invalid port\n";' \
'open my $g,"-|","getent","ahostsv4",$host or die "DNS lookup failed\n";' \
'my @ips; while(<$g>){ my ($ip)=split; push @ips,$ip if defined $ip && !grep {$_ eq $ip} @ips } close $g;' \
'@ips or die "hostname has no IPv4 address\n";' \
'sub bad { my $p=inet_aton($_[0]) or return 1; my $n=unpack("N",$p); my @r=([0x00000000,8],[0x0a000000,8],[0x64400000,10],[0x7f000000,8],[0xa9fe0000,16],[0xac100000,12],[0xc0000000,24],[0xc0000200,24],[0xc0586300,24],[0xc0a80000,16],[0xc6120000,15],[0xc6336400,24],[0xcb007100,24],[0xe0000000,4],[0xf0000000,4]); for(@r){my($b,$bits)=@$_; my $m=(0xffffffff << (32-$bits)) & 0xffffffff; return 1 if (($n&$m)==($b&$m));} return 0 }' \
'for(@ips){ bad($_) and die "destination resolves to a non-public address\n" }' \
'print "$host\n$port\n$ips[0]\n";' > /verb/validate.pl && printf '%s\n' \
'#!/usr/bin/perl' \
'use strict; use warnings;' \
'local $/; my $s=<STDIN> // "";' \
'$s =~ s/<!--.*?-->//gs; $s =~ s{<(script|style|noscript|template|svg)\b.*?</\1\s*>}{}gis;' \
'$s =~ s{<(?:br|/?p|/?div|/?li|/?tr|/?h[1-6]|/?title|/?main|/?article|/?section)\b[^>]*>}{\n}gi;' \
'$s =~ s/<[^>]*>/ /gs;' \
'$s =~ s/ / /gi; $s =~ s/&/&/gi; $s =~ s/</</gi; $s =~ s/>/>/gi; $s =~ s/"/"/gi;' \
'$s =~ s/[ \t\r\f]+/ /g; $s =~ s/ *\n */\n/g; $s =~ s/\n{3,}/\n\n/g; $s =~ s/^\s+|\s+$//g;' \
'print substr($s,0,200000),"\n";' > /verb/clean.pl && printf '%s\n' \
'#!/bin/sh' \
'set -eu' \
'url=$1' \
'meta=$(/verb/validate.pl "$url") || exit 1' \
'host=$(printf "%s\n" "$meta" | sed -n "1p")' \
'port=$(printf "%s\n" "$meta" | sed -n "2p")' \
'ip=$(printf "%s\n" "$meta" | sed -n "3p")' \
'tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap '\''rm -rf "$tmp"'\'' EXIT HUP INT TERM' \
'if ! curl --silent --show-error --fail --proto "=http,https" --max-redirs 0 --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 15 --max-filesize 1048576 --request GET --header "Accept: text/html, text/plain;q=0.9, application/xhtml+xml;q=0.8" --header "Accept-Encoding: identity" --user-agent "read_page/1.0" --resolve "$host:$port:$ip" --dump-header "$tmp/head" --output "$tmp/body" "$url"; then echo "error: could not fetch page (redirects are not followed)" >&2; exit 1; fi' \
'test $(wc -c < "$tmp/body") -le 1048576 || { echo "error: page exceeds 1 MiB" >&2; exit 1; }' \
'ctype=$(sed -n '\''s/^[Cc]ontent-[Tt]ype:[[:space:]]*\([^;[:space:]]*\).*/\1/p'\'' "$tmp/head" | tail -1 | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")' \
'case "$ctype" in text/html|text/plain|application/xhtml+xml) ;; *) echo "error: unsupported content type: ${ctype:-unknown}" >&2; exit 1;; esac' \
'case "$ctype" in text/plain) head -c 200000 "$tmp/body";; *) /verb/clean.pl < "$tmp/body";; esac' > /verb/run.sh && chmod 0555 /verb/*.pl /verb/run.sh

verb.dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates
RUN mkdir -p /src && printf '%s\n' 'package main' 'import (' '  "bytes"' '  "encoding/json"' '  "fmt"' '  "io"' '  "net/http"' '  "net/url"' '  "os"' '  "strings"' '  "time"' ')' 'func main() {' '  if len(os.Args) != 2 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: tavily_extract URL"); os.Exit(2) }' '  u, err := url.Parse(os.Args[1])' '  if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https") || u.Host == "" || u.User != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "URL must be HTTP(S), have a host, and contain no credentials"); os.Exit(2) }' '  keyBytes, err := os.ReadFile("/state/secrets/tavily_api_key")' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily API key is not provisioned"); os.Exit(1) }' '  key := strings.TrimSpace(string(keyBytes))' '  if key == "" { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily API key is empty"); os.Exit(1) }' '  payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"urls": []string{u.String()}, "format": "markdown"})' '  req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.tavily.com/extract", bytes.NewReader(payload))' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "request creation failed"); os.Exit(1) }' '  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)' '  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")' '  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 45 * time.Second}' '  resp, err := client.Do(req)' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily request failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' '  defer resp.Body.Close()' '  body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 2*1024*1024+1))' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "could not read Tavily response"); os.Exit(1) }' '  if len(body) > 2*1024*1024 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily response exceeded 2 MiB"); os.Exit(1) }' '  if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 { fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Tavily returned HTTP %d\n", resp.StatusCode); os.Exit(1) }' '  fmt.Print(string(body))' '}' > /src/main.go
RUN cd /src && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o /tavily_extract main.go
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=build /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
COPY --from=build /tavily_extract /verb/tavily_extract
ENTRYPOINT ["/verb/tavily_extract"]
